problem: Roommates often forget or argue about household chores, leading to tension and uneven workload distribution because there is no simple shared tool to assign, track, and confirm completion of chores.
solution: A lightweight offline‑first web app that lets roommates create a shared chore list, assign tasks, set recurrence, and mark completion. Data is stored locally and can be synced manually via QR code or copy‑paste for small groups.

competitors.name: OurHome
competitors.difference: OurHome is a mobile app with cloud sync and paid premium; this product is a static web app with no backend, free and privacy‑first.

competitors.name: Tody
competitors.difference: Tody focuses on personal cleaning schedules; ours is collaborative for multiple housemates with simple sharing.

competitors.name: Flatmate
competitors.difference: Flatmate includes rent splitting and chat; we focus solely on chore management with zero‑install web access.

features: Mark chores as completed with timestamp
Export/import data as JSON for manual sync
Responsive design for phone and desktop

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a paid "Pro" version that adds cloud sync via a low‑cost third‑party storage API and custom themes; 5% of active users may upgrade at $2.99/month.
monetization.free_tier: All core features remain free; no ads, no data collection.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free-tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish repository on GitHub with GitHub Pages enabled
Share the link in university housing forums and Reddit r/roommates
Collect feedback via a short Google Form and iterate

marketing_content.tagline: Keep the peace, share the chores.
marketing_content.social_post: Tired of chore wars with your roommates? 🎯 Try Roommate Chore Tracker – a free, privacy‑first web app that lets you assign, schedule, and confirm chores together. No app store, no login, just a link you can share. #Roommates #Productivity

tests: Create a new chore, assign to "Alex", set weekly recurrence, mark completed – verify it appears in the completed list with correct date.
Export data, clear local storage, import the same JSON – verify all chores and assignments are restored.
next_improvements: Add QR code based data sharing for quick sync between devices
Implement optional email reminders for upcoming chores
Provide a simple analytics view of chore distribution per housemate
